name: Pain Siphon
source:
A psychological horror kinetic visual novel about a magical healer who can absorb and process human suffering told from the point of view of his proxy and caretaker.

[From [url=https://priro.itch.io/pain-siphon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部心理恐怖单线视觉小说，从代理者兼照料者的视角出发，讲述一位能够吸收并化解人类苦痛的魔法治疗师的故事。

[摘自[url=https://priro.itch.io/pain-siphon]itch.io[/url]]
